Wonderful service. My dog ​​was rescued and is afraid of water. The groomer was very patient and careful.

I was very surprised from the moment I arrived. They are dedicated to meticulously learning about your dog. They note every scar (in my case, since they were rescued, there are several), ask about allergies, and touch the entire dog before taking it for a bath.
In the bath, they use chromotherapy and soft music.
My 50kg, almost 10-year-old Labrador, recently recovered from extensive abdominal surgery, was carried with great care to avoid putting pressure on his belly.
My dog, who always tries to jump off the table, was calm.
In addition to the care, it's important to mention the clean environment and committed professionals.
To this day, the best place I've taken my dogs for a bath.
